name: @drakkar.software/octobot-protocol
description: JSON Schema protocol types and codegen

scripts.test: npm run test:postprocess && npm run test:postprocess:codegen && python -m pytest test -q
scripts.generate:python: node scripts/clean-protocol-codegen-output.mjs python && openapi-generator-cli generate -i openapi.json -g python -o . -t openapi_generator_templates/python --global-property models,modelTests=true,supportingFiles=__init__.py --additional-properties packageName=octobot_protocol,useOneOfDiscriminatorLookup=true,generateAliasAsModel=true && npm run test:models
scripts.generate:typescript: node scripts/clean-protocol-codegen-output.mjs typescript && openapi-generator-cli generate -i openapi.json -g typescript -o octobot_protocol_ts --global-property models --additional-properties modelPropertyNaming=original,stringEnums=true,supportsES6=true,useOneOfDiscriminatorLookup=true && node scripts/postprocess-protocol-typescript.mjs
scripts.generate:rust: node scripts/clean-protocol-codegen-output.mjs rust && openapi-generator-cli generate -i openapi.json -g rust -o octobot_protocol_rs --global-property models --additional-properties packageName=octobot_protocol_rs,useOneOfDiscriminatorLookup=true
scripts.generate:all: npm run generate:python && npm run generate:typescript
